To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the MSSM Higgs sector may be fully probed at the LC; (ii) the MSSM may be tested in the decoupled regime; (iii) the MSSM parameter space may be explored in a model--independent way; and (iv) the MSSM and the NMSSM may be distinguished at the LC.

(a) the LC can be used to determine fundamental SUSY and $H/A$ parameters in the decoupled regime, including CP violating phases, with a precision comparable to the LHC, (b) the LC can probe the NMSSM at the electrowek scale and determine its fundamental parameters.

(a) the Higgs sector in the MSSM can be explored at a LC with a precision comparable to that of the Tevatron and the LHC; (b) the MSSM Higgs sector is very sensitive to the CP--violating phase $\phi_{\tilde{A}}$, which can be determined with a high accuracy, and to the ratio $v_u/v_d$ of the vacuum expectation values of the two Higgs doublets.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the MSSM and NMSSM in view of a future linear collider.
the physics of the Higgs sector in the MSSM.
the physics of the electroweek scale and its possible extensions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, if SUSY is realized at the scale $\sim 1\,$TeV and if the Higgs mass is $\sim 115\,$GeV, then the LC is the best machine for probing the MSSM.
the LC is a powerful tool for probing the Higgs sector, the SUSY breaking sector, and the SUSY flavor sector.
the LC will provide an ideal environment for probing the Higgs sector of SUSY models.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a LC is an excellent place to study supersymmetry and Higgs physics.
the LC is the best machine for determining the SUSY and HISS parameters.
the LC will be a powerful tool for probing the underlying structure of supersymmetry.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a high--luminosity LC can provide a unique and powerful means for exploring the SUSY and Higg sectors of the MSSM and beyond.
, with a few percent accuracy, the Higgs mass and mixing angle can be determined at the LC, and that the next--to-minimal supersymmetric standard model is testable at the LC with the same accuracy.
the LC will provide an excellent opportunity to probe SUSY and HISS physics in the decoupled regime and to measure fundamental parameters of the Higgs sector.
